batting.name: S Sohal
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b RP Singh

batting.name: SM Katich
batting.dismissal: c PP Ojha b A Symonds

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c RJ Harris b RP Singh

batting.name: WA Mota
batting.dismissal: c RJ Harris b TL Suman

batting.name: IK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c HH Gibbs b RP Singh

batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: st KC Sangakkara b RR Powar

batting.name: HH Gibbs
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b Yuvraj Singh

batting.name: A Symonds
batting.dismissal: st KC Sangakkara b Yuvraj Singh

balls.text: makes room, hits over the off side field, and gets a single to sweeper-cover
action replay, stays low again, Lee misses on an almighty slash, but this time they steal a bye
this one stays low, back of a length, angled across, Lee gives it his all, but plays all over it
another bouncer to Lee, surely that's the plan, but it's too high
RP extends his lead, another length ball, Pathan's eyes lit up, he gets under it, too much under it, and skies it straight to Gibbs at long-on. Perhaps it stopped on him a touch
superb work at deep backward square by Teja, this was a length ball, pulled square, where Teja runs fast and across, and saves a boundary with one hand
full, outside off, cross-batted towards wide of long-on, they run through for two, they go to the third umpire at the striker's end, but Pathan is in comfortably
another short one, and Lee plays with an open face, towards the man in front of point, superb over, three dots in a row
another bouncer, this is really sharp, 142ks as opposed to his usual mid-130s, Lee tries upper-cut again, and misses again
tries the bounder again, Lee sways out of the line, and goes for the upper cut, but this one got a bit big and Lee misses
makes room this time, this is fuller, angling across, and he hits towards sweeper-cover
that's a badly needed boundary, poor bowling, length ball, on the pads, Pathan gets under it, and hits it to deep backward square
back of a length, angling across, Pathan swishes, and connects just the air
that's a big strike, and RP gets the purple cap with that, length ball, Sanga hits it hard down the ground, but straight to Harris at wide long-on. Not quite worked out by RP, but he will take it
bouncer, and Irfan pulls off the front foot, and it's just a single to deep backward square
just short of yorker length, crisply hit, with an open face, right enough of sweeper-cover to allow them to come back for two
back of a length, angling in, cramps him for room, and only a single to long-on ensues
back of a length, tailing in towards the stumps, and played with an open face towards third man
full and wide, and driven uppishly towards sweeper-cover
thrown up on leg, and Irfan misses on the sweep

and RP is pedestrian here, this is just dabbed towards short third, where RP runs towards the ball and doesn't dive, then turns at right angles after the ball passes him, the chase is not too hot either, and the desperate dive in the end doesn't prevent four
on the pads, and Sanga opens up and sweeps towards deep backward sqaure
once again, he follows a boundary with a smart shot, dabs this one towards wide of long-on, it doesn't have enough power in it and they run two
and Sanga is on fire, gets to his fifty, with a superb pull shot, this was short all right, but he finds the gap between square leg and midwicket

and gets a wicket first ball, thrown up outside off, and Mota goes for a slog sweep, gets a top edge towards cow corner - long-n is wide, Harris completes an easy catch. Another bowling change that has worked
follows it up with a smart shot, makes room, dabs a length ball to square of third man, takes on the throw, and completes a couple
Sanga is warming up, round the wicket, angling in, he picks it from the pads nonchalantly, and clears midwicket easily. Top shot
back of a length again, and helped towards the third man
tries the short one, Mota makes room and slashes, and misses it royally
angling in to the pads, and Sanga flicks it down to fine leg
and he bowls length, Mota slashes, gets it to sweeper-cover
shot of the day, just two though, this was flighted, and lofted straight back over the bowler, bisects long-off and long-on, but doesn't have the pace to go to the boundary
frenetic running, this was a fulltoss, hit firmly to long-off, but they decided from the off that they were going for two, and Mota is just in - a direct hit would have got him
better line and length, in front of stumps, just back of a length, and played down the ground
improvises this time, picks this from in front of stumps, and paddles it fine, really fine, so fine they get three of it
another one, short and wide, and this time Sanga is more subtle, opening the face late, and beating point, result is the same
and bowls short and wide to Sanga obliges with a ferocious cut, that flies to the boundary
straighter one, pitches the same spot from where it ripped three balls ago, but this one goes straight with the arm and hurries Mota into a defensive shot
improvises, this was thrown wide outside off, and Sanga sweeps, between midwicket and square leg, will be just one though
looks to sweep again, but can't beat the short fine, and they manage a quick single
that's a ripper, angled in towards the stumps, turning upon pitching, and beats a prod, lovely bowling
Sanga steps out again, Ojha pulls the length back, and Sanga manages to play down the ground
full and straight, and swept away towards fine leg
short and pulled away towards midwicket
full, on the stumps, and hit back to bowler, Suman misfields, his path obstructed by the non-striker
short, Sanga looks to pull, but is somehow hurried into the shot, and can't beat square leg
and the pressure shows, Sanga springs out of the wicket, Suman drags it back, the spin gets a thick outside edge, and they get two to third man
another dot ball, floated again, turning across him, and defended towards cover
floated, turning across, 84ks, and defended with an open face
that's a half-volley, outside off, but hit straight towards long-off
turn here, from just outside off and from a length, gets Mota's edge, but this goes wide of the slip (yes they have a slip)
fulltoss, cross-batted towards wide long-on but just a single
round the wicket to Mota, no turn, but this is accurate and skids on, played towards cover for a single
steps down, is beaten by the flight, and he helps it into the leg side still, and gets a single
this will break the dry spell, clean, orthodox sweep, crisp too, and clears square leg inside the circle and gets four
over the wicket to Sanga, turning in, and he plays it straight towards short fine
straighter one again, but this is not quick, and Sanga punches it down the ground
throws it up, turns in too, he defends, gets the inside half off the bat, and they scamper through for a single
angled into Sanga's pads, and he helps it towards fine leg
paddle sweep, from outside off, looks for two but chooses against it
almost gone, short and wide, stayed a bit low, and Mota cut straight towards cover, falls just short
full outside off, and driven towards the sweeper-cover
Sanga flicks this one from in front of the stumps, and gets a single to midwicket
full, into the pads, and turned away towards midwicket
length ball, thrown up, just outside off, and turning in, Mota defends with an open face
gets too straight this time, and Sanga turns it round the corner for a single
thrown up again, in front of stumps, Sanga is short of the pitch and defends in front of his body
flighted off break, from outside leg, turning towards stumps, and misses the sweep
back of a length, turns in, and Mota defends it off the back foot

Venu has got Yuvraj, with a faster, flatter delivery. This was bowled at 90ks, pitched just back of a length, just outside off, and hurried Yuvraj who was late in coming down on it. The middle stump is disturbed, Venu is elated
short, and this one angles in, and Sanga manages to cut it away
slows it down, turns away from outside off, misses the prod from Sanga
stays full again, just outside off, Yuvraj drives it towards sweeper-cover
full and wide outside off, and driven with open face towards sweeper-cover
this one turns sharply, bites from in front of leg, and almost beats Gilchrist too, but he gets a hand to it, the ball bounces towards short third
thrown up, outside leg, turning towards the stumps, and Sanga flicks it towards fine leg
full, on the pads, and turned round the corner
goes down the leg side, Yuvraj goes for the sweep, but fails to connect
thrown up, on off stump, and defended, wants to have a look
bowls full, on the pads, flicked towards midwicket
driven straight back to Rohit, it was full and hit hard
that asked for four runs, short, very short, and wide, and Yuvraj picks extra cover and connects
gets too straight, and turned round the corner
thrown up, turns away after pitching in front of off, and defended with an open face
short, very short, and hit straight down the ground
angling into the pads, and guided towards fine leg
driving length again, Yuvraj drives crispily, straight towards Symonds at cover
full and wide, Sanga looks to drive, but the face opens too early, thick outside edge goes to third man
full, drivable length, Sanga does, towards mid-on, but can't beat the fielder
driven from outside off, and with an open face, a single to third man
full, angling across, and left alone
that was full and sharp, 136ks, angling across Yuvraj, who hangs his bat and gets a thick outside edge, between slip and third man who is square
angling across Sangakkara, and he dabs it down, but can't get a quick single
short and wide, and he cuts it away to sweeper-cover
that's lethal nonchalance, this was short, on the leg stump, Yuvraj stands tall, and flick-pulls it, flat over midwicket, one of the flatter sixes
good line, back of a length, starts on leg, angles across, and left alone

and he's gone, the ides is right, execution is not, he goes across again, gets on a knee, and looks to loft a length ball over mid-on. But this is not connected properly, and Ojha has to take just four steps back to take the catch
short, angling across, Katich walks across and cuts, but can't beat a diving Gibbs
short and wide and cut away towards third man
Katich is opening up the leg side beautifully, though this was very short, Katich goes back and across, and there is the whole leg side to choose from, this time rolls his wrists and goes square
fuller this time, just outside off, and played towards mid-off
that's a dismissive pull, another short delivery, Katich goes back and across, and pulls in front of midwicket
that's strange, maybe Yuvraj didn't pick it, back of a length, outside off, he looks to leave it, but the ball finds the bat and goes towards thirdman
Katich walks across, and flicks this length delivery to fine leg
angling across Yuvraj, he lets it go

remember what Momma said? Don't run off a misfield. Katich plays it straight towards Gibbs at cover, wait is the call although he has taken a few steps down, Gibbs fumbles, Katich comes through, Pomersbach is late to start, and Gibbs's throw is accurate, bye bye Luke
big wide down the leg side, fourth wide of the innings
fuller, angling across, driven crisply, but they have a sweeper-cover back
on the target, just back of a length, on the stumps, and defended off the back foot
short and wide, but it's so slow, Symonds has to play it down the ground, gets an easy single
Katich plays for the first time today, and plays a length ball towards cover
tries too much, too early, walks across again, looks to scoop this time over short fine, doesn't connect, it lobs limply towards the fielder, Rohit Sharma takes three steps back and takes a sitter
the walk across the stumps works, this is a touch fuller, and he picks it from in front of off, to over midwicket, and gets two for that chip
tries the same line, just outside off, just back of a length, Sohal moves across, and defends it back to the bowler
back of a length again, just outside off, and Sohal plays without feet, can't get it past backward point
just back of a length, starts off, moves away, Sohal goes fishing, doesn't catch anything
third wide of the innings, but this is an interesting one, wide outside off, and it died on Gilchrist
on target right away, length delivery, on the stumps, and defended
length ball outside off, and drives to wide of extra cover
slashes again, and misses, this one was just outside off
tries the same shot, this is fuller, though, and he gets a bottom edge, and it's safe
one bouncer too many, this is straight over the stumps, Sohal makes room, slashes it over point, big six it is
now he gets the line right, short again, outside off, and this one bounces, up till Gilchrist's face
shorter and farther down the leg side
short again, looks to tuck him up, goes too far down the leg side, and it's a wide
short and wide, moves away a touch, and Sohal plays it towards gully

Punjab have won this. Fulltoss on off stump, Harris crashes it through the off side, Lee fields at sweeper-cover, there is a fumble that allows them the second. Jaskaran Singh wants the third, but Harris is so disappointed he is not even looking. Jaskaran would have had a fair shot at the third run that could have tied the game. This still would have been a run-out in all possibility because the throw was on target, but Harris should have run the third. Even Sanga, the keeper, can't believe it

has Pathan done it once and for all? Can't say by the way this match has gone, another slower ball, moves away from RP, who looks for another slog, gets the toe end, and the ball lobs back to the right of Pathan
Slower ball, Singh looks for a loft over midwicket, misses, and the ball bounces over the stumps by inches
and the game turns again, length ball again, Rohit looks to go midwicket, misses, Pathan hits the leg stump, what a game, what an over
and a wide, what's happening here, wide yorker outside off

and Sharma enjoys the luck he deserves after two superb back-to-back innings, slower ball, length ball, Sharma looks extra cover, loses his shape, gets a thick edge, it goes over short third man, and it's four all the way
slower ball, makes room once again, hits to long-off, runs two, as if their life depended on that, well done Harris
good comeback, but has the damage been done? yorker, on the off stump, Sharma digs it out and gets a single
Lee loses the script, Sharma stays cool, no-ball, yorker outside off, Sharma makes room and crashes it through point. 5 runs and a free hit to boot
length ball, and Rohit hits another six, what are you made of Sharma, cleared the front leg, and played a pick-up, over deep backward square this time
and Rohit runs again even before the ball reaches the batsman, this is another bouncer that Harris misses, but Rohit makes the bye. Touch and go for a wide for height
length ball, on the stumps, Sharma slogs towards midwicket, where Powar dives superbly to keep them down to one

Rohit takes it all in his hand, he runs even before the ball has reached the batsman. It's a slower bouncer, which Teja misses, but Rohit is taking the single come hail or storm. Teja is late, and Lee gets him at the non-striker's end
Teja tries the big shot, as opposed to a single, makes room, slashes outside off, and misses

intelligent, very intelligent, he goes for the scoop this time, and connects the length ball cleanly, clearing the short fine eaily, 18 off the over, Yuvraj will ask himself again and again about this bowling chase if Punjab lose
length ball, just outside off, and Sharma goes midwicket again, misses it completely this time
uff Sharma is up to it again, another fulltoss, this one low, Sharma clears the front leg, and goes midwicket again
Sharma threatens a reprise, this was a fulltoss, and he rocks back into the crease and launches it into the scoreboard behind midwicket
swinging yorker, swinging in late, and played towards deep backward square
full, just short of a yorker, and played towards deep point, Punjab will take singles
Sharma makes room, Pathan goes wide, smart bowling, and he gets just a single down to long-off
lovely yorker, can't do anything with it
superb fielding by Pathan. Sharma steps down, hits a short ball down the ground, but Pathan stretches to his right and fields cleanly
full and low, and Teja hits it down the ground for a single
another slower one, around off, Teja looks for the big slog, and this doesn't rise, and goes under the bat
starts with a slower ball, offcutter, Teja is early into the shot, checks and plays towards point
another valuable dot ball, thrown up outside off, and driven straight to cover
short, very short, and pulled away to deep backward square
outside off, Sharma looks for the cut, but it is too full, and gets an underside edge
a floater, doesn't turn much, targeted at off stump, and played down to long -off
thrown up on the stumps, and played down the ground for a single
just short of a length, outside off, and played straight to cover
goes wide of the crease, flights it outside off, and Teja drives it with an open face towards point
slower now, flighted outside off, and turns away, defended towards mid-off
that's a quick legbreak, gets an edge, hurrying Teja into the shot, but there is no slip, he gets four
flighted outside off, and hit straight to sweeper-cover
short, just outside off, and hit to cover
dropped, it was flighted, and hit straight back, low to Chawla, and he missed it completely, he is hit on the shin to make matters worse
short, outside off, and defended off the back foot
flighted on the off stump, and defended to cover
flat, on the off stump, and defended off the back foot
silly point, slip, slow fulltoss, and hit towards extra cover for two

oh Yuvraj you beauty! flat arm ball, just outside off, Venu lets it go, but this one angles in fast and furious, takes the off stump out. Would you believe it? Second hat-trick for Yuvraj. He had taken a wicket last ball of the last over. Even he doesn't realise it

a lovely stumping, what recovery from Sangakkara. Lovely bowling to begin with, drawing Symonds out, turning it across Symonds, Sanga doesn't collect it cleanly, but gets it on the rebound, falling down at the same time, and whips the bails off. Replays show he had flicked one bail off while falling down, and he didn't have the ball in his hand then. The third umpire has given it, the rules say if only one bail is off, you can remove the second bail and get the stumping
low fulltoss, and Symonds hits it down to long-off
that's a bouncer, second for the over, and thought it's not a wide, it certainly is a no-ball
slower one, outside off, Sharma leans in and drives to sweeper-cover
good bouncer, 144ks, head high, Sharma does well, keeps his wrists low and moves out of the way
short, just outside off, Sharma stands tall, and flicks it into the on side, slow enough for them to come back for two
length ball, on the stumps, slight shape, and defended with an open face
full, tailing in to the stumps, and Symonds get a single down to long-on

Chawla makes up for that easy single, this was short and wide, and was cut away powerfully, but high to the left of point, where Chawla dives, completes the catch and makes sure it doesn't pop out when he falls on the ground
thrown up, played towards cover
another single stolen, dabbed towards point, and Yuvraj shouts c'mon, but they are too quick for Chawla
flat, outside off, turns away, and left alone
full and flat, and smart batting from Symonds, hits to wide of long-on, and they run fast for a two
and Yuvraj beats Symonds. Is this a stumping? drew Symonds into the shot, who dragged his foot out, the ball broke away, but Symonds got his foot back in time
short and on the pads, and Symonds helps himself to a single
short outside off, and he gets a single to right of point
flatter this time, hurries Gibbs into a defensive shot
flighted just outside off, driven to cover
another flighted delivery, and Symonds gets an inside edge this time, but he will get a single to short fine
full, flighted, outside off, and Symonds drives it hard, a diving stop Katich at extra cover prevents the four
and they get a smart two again, it's played with soft hands to wide of long-on, and needless to say Gibbs and Symonds are superfast between the stumps
beaten outside off, no big turn, but the slight turn is enough
slower, on the stumps, and Gibbs plays it back to Yuvraj
flat outside off, and defended
thrown up, slower, Gibbs is early, has to abort the cover drive and play it straight down the ground, but gets two
floated outside off, and defended with an open face
hit towards long-on, two is the initial call, but they take one, but Lee hits the stumps direct and gives away the second
good shot this time, driven from outside off, wide of long-off and gets two
wide of the crease, slower in the air, overspinner, and beats Symonds on a waft
this one turned, from middle to off, Gibbs plays it with soft hands, and runs through for a quick single, Yuvraj is quick with a direct hit, but Gibbs is in
full, flat, and an easy single again to long-on
Chawla flights this time, but too full, on the pads and an easy single
subtle change, the trajectory is low this time, and Symonds defends in front of off stump
flighted, this breaks in, and Gibbs waits for it without committing, and gets a single to square leg
another flighted delivery, but too full and too wide, and hit down to long-off
throws it up again, and smartly hit to wide of long-on, and they run two
full, on the stumps, and turns into the pads, defended
lovely bowling again, this one hung in the air, and then seemed to hurry as it pitched, but unfortunately it turned down the leg side
he is shorter this time, and Symonds punches it back to him
pulls the length back a bit, giving it the time to turn, and it beats Gibbs on a defensive shot
flighted again, but too full, although it is hit straight to cover
flighted on the off stump, and driven towards cover
shorter, flatter, 84ks, and cut to backward point
full again, on the off stump, and driven to wide of long-off, and an easy two
thrown up on off, and Synmonds hits it down the ground
the first ordinary ball of the over, angling in, on a length, and Gibbs hits it all along the ground, wide of midwicket, gets four for it
full on the pads, and hit towards deep midwicket
full and straight, played towards wide of mid-on, will get one
left alone, this is close to off stump, shapes a bit, and Gibbs lets it go, misses the off stump by not much
Sreesanth stays on the target, off stump and thereabout, straighteens after pitching on a length, defended
full and straight, shaping away, and played towards cover
slower still, spins from off to leg, goes to leg slip off Symonds's pad
flatter, on the stumps, turned towards fine leg, and they scamper through for two
and what does he do, he lofts it over mid-on, thrown up again, Symonds stays in his crease, and just nonchalantly clears it mid-on
Powar you beauty, dip, drift and break, thrown up again, Suman steps out, the drift takes it away, beats the big heave, and - hook, line and sinker - it gets the middle stump

this is superb bowling, an offspinner's dream, flighted generously, draws Gilchrist out, and then it dips, pitches two feet short than what Gilchrist expects, and this breaks away big, from outside leg to outside off, and an easy stumping, lovely dismissal
thrown up, pitches middle, and spins away, and played towards cover
superb channel again, length ball, starts off, and swings away, and Gibbs defends again
this is better still, length ball, starts off stump, swings away, and he defends
good recovery, length ball, swinging away, and Gibbs lets it go
fine leg up, and he throws this one down his pads, Gibbs says thank you, I'll take it, and flicks it wide of the solitary fielder behind square
just back of a length, on the stumps, and played down towards mid-on
starts with a short and wide on, Gibbs premedidates on the charge, gets the toe end of his bat, lobbing towards mid-off, falls just short of Yuvraj, perhaps half a second late in moving in
full, on the stumps, driven back hard at him, Lee fields
tries a bouncer to tuck him up, but again doesn't get enough bounce, Gilchrist waits for it, and waits an extra mili second to place it wide of deep midwicket
length ball, on the pads, swinging in, and played towards square leg
slower ball, 114ks, full, swinging a touch, no feet from Gibbs, and it gets a thick outside edge towards third man
tries another short one, this one doesn't rise too much, and he pulls it to deep backward square, and it's two
slips in a bouncer, catches Gibbs by surprise, and he ducks
horrible over for Pathan, over corrects, and goes too straight, he knows the fine leg is square, and kicks the ground as Gilchrist flicks it for four more
that's the best shot of the lot, full and wide again, and this time Gilchrist opens the face on the drive, and hits it between point and cover, and the timing is superb
full and wide this time, and driven hard, but can't beat cover
that's gone to Zimbabwe, okay bye, full, on the pads, and he frees his arms on it, goes over midwicket, what a shot
against the swing, but it's too short, and the pull shot is a safe bet against this pace, pulled off the front foot, and over midwicket
Pathan gets some swing too, but it's too wide to induce Gilchrist into a shot
and beats him again, full, outswinger, no feet again, and lucky to not get an edge
slower ball, 124ks, Gibbs goes for the pull, is an hour early into it, lucky that the ball bounces over the stumps
faster they come, the faster they go, this was one was straight and fast, just outside off, not a half-volley, Gibbs stands tall, and plays it on the up, crashing through the covers
full, and swinging away, 148ks, Gibbs pokes without any feet, and misses
full, and swinging, Gilchrist plays it down towards mid-off, quick single
Oz to Oz, length ball, swinging in, hits him on the thigh pad, 144ks
